title: Evaluating Dynamic Topic Models
subcategory: temporal evaluation measures for dynamic topic models
task: Measuring the quality of topic evolution in dynamic topic models
problem: Existing measures score each time slice separately and do not evaluate how topics change over time.
architecture: Temporal Topic Coherence (NPMI over word pairs across consecutive timestamps of a topic), Temporal Topic Smoothness (inverse diversity of a topic over a time window), their product Temporal Topic Quality, and Dynamic Topic Quality combining year-wise and temporal quality; validated with synthetic noise, temporal word intrusion and human ratings (18 annotators).
llm_or_encoder: none (evaluates D-LDA, D-ETM and an LLM-based baseline)
metrics: Spearman correlation with intrusion and human ratings
baselines: year-wise topic coherence and diversity baselines (B-TC, B-TS)
key_results: Spearman correlation with temporal word intrusion: 0.87-0.98 (D-LDA) and 0.88-0.98 (D-ETM) across measures and datasets.
Human ratings: TTC rho 0.57 / 0.63 / 0.51 vs baseline coherence 0.21 / 0.17 / -0.02 on NeurIPS / NYT / UN.
strengths: First measures dedicated to temporal topic quality, validated by humans.

limitations.text: Non-expert annotators; results depend on the reference corpus, which may be thin for some time steps.
TTS is not better than the baseline smoothness on NYT and UN (0.82 vs 0.83, 0.79 vs 0.81).
